title: Verification For A G Suite Account (Gmail) For Email
text:
## Verification For A G Suite Account (Gmail) For Email
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000020258
G Suite is our recommended solution for 3rd party email platforms.
Note that Google changes their workflow and design often, so the steps below may not be 100% accurate at the time of reading.  For the most up to date documentation from Google on this topic, reference their documentation here: https://support.google.com/a/answer/172171?hl=en&ref_topic=2705493
To verify a G Suite Accountfollow these instructions -
Go to https://gsuite.google.com/products/gmail/ and click on "Get Started":
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12075742390/original/-LpXY_LojjJOY7-MDzUwj2RbBA-uN-9E7Q.png?1585612229 | alt: ]

## Verification Process:
Now it is time to add one of the ways provided by Google for the "Verification Step" -
1. CNAME:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12075742585/original/7w71qu7EuENSurPeM684K9I7dhyECC1GuQ.png?1585612815 | alt: ]
2. TXT Record:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12075742600/original/__hUCheTvHs74Tq4cPpVck3uDW8Of2UWhw.png?1585612868 | alt: ]
Login to the admin of a website and go to Developer Hub » cPanel Dashboard » " Zone Editor ":
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12094923324/original/CehrXm86rDQOA0hH9gmCO1Bqn0UmtPbgTw.png?1625182100 | alt: ]
**Important Note: The cPanel dashboard layout is continuously being updated, however, all the instructions presented in this article apply in the same way.
